component.name: Sysograph
component.summary: A free system task manager for Linux

description.p: Sysograph is an original, free system task manager for Linux built with C++ and GTK 4. It gives you a complete picture of what your machine is doing: processes with full details, a process tree, performance graphs for CPU, memory, disk and network, per-user resource aggregation, XDG autostart entries and systemd services.
It runs entirely without root privileges, reads its data from the standard procfs and sysfs interfaces, and collects or sends nothing.

Sysograph — свободный диспетчер задач для Linux на C++ и GTK 4: процессы с подробностями, дерево процессов, графики ЦП, памяти, диска и сети, потребление по пользователям, автозапуск и службы systemd. Работает без прав root, не собирает и не отправляет данные.
Process table with search, sorting and details pane, process tree, performance graphs, per-user aggregation, XDG autostart management and systemd service listing; DEB/RPM packaging.
